description: This file is a PHP template for rendering a user’s investors page in a web application. It includes layout setup, fetching and displaying a list of investors with pagination, and embedding various other template widgets.

classes.name: Paginated
classes.description: A utility class for managing paginated data sets.

methods.name: fetchPagedRow
methods.description: Retrieves a row from the paginated data set.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets the layout object for rendering pagination navigation.

methods.name: fetchPagedNavigation
methods.description: Generates the HTML for pagination navigation links.
